title: Shift a Two-Dimensional Grid
description: Shift every element of a rectangular grid `k` positions forward in row-major order, wrapping elements that pass the end back to the beginning. Return a new grid with the same dimensions. Input: `grid`, non-negative `k`. Output: the shifted grid.
hints: Check each cell using its row and column relationships.
Handle single-row, single-column, tie, and center-cell cases explicitly.
